title: The Barn | R&SVP – Hio Ridge, Bridgton, Maine
description: Inside the restored 1820 barn at Hio Ridge: main floor and loft for 135 guests, bridal and groom rooms, a prep kitchen, a patio and a ceremony field.
heading: The Barn
lede: A 206-year-old barn, lowered 12 inches to meet code, lined with its own original boards, and lit by the 200-year-old windows from the house. Tables and chairs are included with rental.
hero_alt: Looking down the barn toward the French doors, a chandelier overhead and the loft rail on both sides

spaces.title: The main floor
spaces.body: Ceremony seating for your guests, or dining at 6-foot and 8-foot tables or 5-foot rounds. We have tried the layouts: rows for a ceremony, long tables down the length of the barn, or rounds with room to move. The main floor opens through French doors onto the patio.
spaces.alt: The main floor of the barn, timber posts and beams, chandeliers, loft rail above

spaces.title: The loft
spaces.body: A second level with its own dining space, looking down into the barn. Upstairs dining seats 20 on one side and 18 on the other.
spaces.alt: The loft of the barn, roof structure and reclaimed windows, a doorway at the end

spaces.title: The bridal room
spaces.body: In the ell, off the hallway with its original celestial window. Sheer curtains, a vanity, an arched mirror, a chandelier, and a hook made for your wedding dress.
spaces.alt: The bridal room with sheer curtains, a vanity and an arched mirror

spaces.title: The groom's room
spaces.body: A second room in the ell for the groom and groomsmen, with a mirror and a bench made from the barn's old beams.
spaces.alt: The groom's room, white walls, exposed beams, a wood bench and a window

spaces.title: The prep kitchen
spaces.body: A kitchen for your caterer, with barn doors on the open sides that close for privacy while they finish the meal. Outside caterers are welcome. [CONFIRM: any caterer requirements]
spaces.alt: The prep kitchen: white cabinets, stainless appliances, barn doors on the open side

spaces.title: The patio and the grounds
spaces.body: A paved patio off the barn with room for nine tables and 72 seats, string lights for the evening, and a paved path around the barn. Two 12-foot stone planters and a seating circle were built from rocks that sat under the barn since 1820. Beyond them, the ceremony field looks at Pleasant Mountain.
spaces.alt: The patio, a stone planter and the boulder seating circle, birches behind

spaces.title: The ceremony field
spaces.body: Benches made from the barn's original floorboards, set in the field. An arbor made from the barn's posts and beams is planned. [CONFIRM: arbor built]
spaces.alt: Benches in the field, birches at the edge, the barn in the distance

facts.label: Included
facts.value: Tables and chairs. 6-foot and 8-foot tables and 5-foot rounds

facts.label: Parking
facts.value: A lot for 66 cars, plus three accessible spaces in the driveway

facts.label: Accessibility
facts.value: A wooden ramp to the main floor, an ADA accessible bathroom, and a paved path around the barn to the patio

facts.label: Alcohol
facts.value: An alcohol-free, family friendly venue. No alcohol, cannabis or smoking at events

facts.label: Catering
facts.value: Outside caterers, with a prep kitchen on site

facts.label: Restrooms
facts.value: [CONFIRM: indoor restrooms and rentals for large events]

closing.heading: Come see it in person
closing.body: There is something about these 1820 beams you have to see for yourself. We give private tours by appointment.
